E1.condition: repeated prefix without a session-affinity header

E2.condition: repeated prefix with a stable session-affinity header

E3.condition: stable affinity with a changed leading system line

boundary: accepted evidence supports a latency association only; consistent hashing preserves a stable placement key by configuration, and direct per-request cache attribution was not measured

method.aggregation: within a repetition, turn 1 is the median across three sessions and turns 2-4 are the median across nine requests; the table reports the median across repetitions; the ratio is computed within each repetition before the median is taken
method.flush: both replica caches flushed before every measured turn
method.metric: TTFT-any: time to the first streamed output event, reasoning or visible
